short_description.value: SkySense V2 is a unified multi-modal remote sensing foundation model (MM-RSFM) that employs a single transformer backbone for multiple modalities (HR optical, multispectral, SAR). It introduces adaptive patch merging, modality prompt tokens, and a mixture of experts module, and is pre-trained with a novel query-based semantic aggregation contrastive learning (QSACL) strategy. It achieves state-of-the-art results across 16 datasets and 7 tasks.

pretext_training_type.value: Self-supervised learning (SSL) with Multi-Granularity Contrastive Learning (MGCL), Query-based Semantic Aggregation Contrastive Learning (QSACL), Dense Image-Text Alignment (ITA), and Geo-Context Prototype Learning (GCPL)

masking_strategy.value: Adaptive Patch Merging (APM) for spatial harmonization; no explicit masking ratio for MIM

pretraining.value: Pre-trained on 21 million multi-modal remote sensing imagery sets (HR optical, Sentinel-2 MS, Sentinel-1 SAR) using a teacher-student architecture with multi-granularity contrastive learning, geo-context prototype learning, dense image-text alignment, and query-based semantic aggregation contrastive learning (QSACL).

value.value: Dense image-text alignment with OSM labels
Mixture of Experts (MoE) in last 6 transformer blocks

temporal_resolution.value: variable (S2: avg 65 images per sequence, S1: avg 10 images per sequence)

dataset.value: 21 million multi-modal RS imagery sets (HR optical, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1)

sampling.value: Random sampling of 10 S2 and 5 S1 images per set per iteration

missing_data.value: Random disturbances on acquisition date; missing handled by sampling
